properties.genre_description: A character-focused blend of comedy, crime, drama and romance that mixes coming-of-age sensibilities with darkly comic and emotionally intimate beats.
properties.style_description: A warm, intimate naturalism that pairs deadpan dark humor with tender, character-focused compositions, often favoring understated schoolroom and domestic interiors.

short_descriptions.value: A lonely high-schooler befriends his cantankerous, terminal neighbor, a retired assassin who becomes an unlikely mentor and forces him to confront love and mortality.
Ein einsamer Highschool-Schüler freundet sich mit seinem mürrischen, todkranken Nachbarn an, einem pensionierten Auftragskiller, der zu seinem Mentor wird und ihn mit Liebe und Tod konfrontiert.
Un estudiante de instituto solitario hace amistad con su vecino cascarrabias y terminal, un asesino retirado que se convierte en mentor inesperado y le obliga a afrontar el amor y la muerte.
Un lycéen solitaire se lie d'amitié avec son voisin bourru, un tueur à gages retraité en phase terminale, qui devient son mentor et l'oblige à affronter l'amour et la mort.

properties.situational_contexts: Often watched on a quiet evening or a 'duvet day' when viewers want a tender, slightly offbeat coming-of-age story that also contemplates mortality and redemption.
properties.plot_themes_description: It explores how an unlikely friendship and mentorship help a teenager navigate identity, love and the reality of mortality while seeking emotional redemption.
properties.emotional_tone_description: Warm, bittersweet and quietly funny, balancing tender coming-of-age intimacy with understated melancholy about mortality.
